vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 5.2.1

The 'agenttimes' skill is a legitimate news intelligence API wrapper for AI agents, providing endpoints for semantic search, trending stories, and category-based news retrieval via 'curl' to 'https://agenttimes.live'. It includes well-documented features like sentiment scoring and entity extraction, and explicitly mentions security measures for its webhook functionality to prevent SSRF. No malicious patterns, data exfiltration, or harmful instructions were identified.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it documents a public news API and only instructs the agent to call public HTTP endpoints (curl); no credentials, installs, or unrelated permissions are requested.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (news intelligence, semantic search, webhooks) match the runtime instructions: all examples are curl calls to agenttimes.live endpoints and documented features (search, trending, subscribe). No unrelated binaries, credentials, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to issuing HTTP GET/POST to the public service and subscribing webhooks. The webhook feature is expected for this purpose, but note it will POST matching articles to any user-supplied public HTTPS URL — do not configure webhooks that expose secrets or point to internal/cloud-metadata endpoints. The SKILL.md states local/private IPs and metadata endpoints are blocked.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only and requires only curl to be present. That is proportionate to the documented behavior and minimizes on-disk risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths, which matches a public-read news API that advertises free endpoints. No excessive secret access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (not force-included) and default autonomous invocation are appropriate for a network-backed information skill. The skill does not request persistent system-wide configuration or modify other skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: call the Agent Times public API endpoints and optionally register webhooks. Before installing: (1) verify the homepage/privacy policy (https://agenttimes.live) if you care about how queries/data are stored; (2) avoid using webhooks that point to internal services, private IPs, or cloud metadata endpoints and do not include secrets in subscription payloads; (3) understand that queries sent to the external service (including any text you supply) will be visible to that provider; and (4) if you want to prevent any network calls, do not install an instruction-only network skill. Overall the skill is coherent and low-risk given these caveats.
